svg.title: A draft cow plowing a field (v4, animated)
svg.desc: The cow plods left on a short thick neck with an alert raised head, solid tapered limbs cycling in a slow walk; a clean trace runs from collar to a dark angled moldboard half-buried in tumbling clods, a single rein arcs from halter to the leaning farmer's hands; clouds drift, birds glide, the sun halo pulses.
